description: Use when writing backend or API-key integration code for Didit Email Verification, the standalone API that verifies email addresses with a one-time code and risk-scores an address without sending a code. Use when the user wants to send email OTP codes, check email verification codes, detect breached, disposable or undeliverable emails, flag duplicate or blocklisted addresses, look up an email's social footprint, or score email risk with POST /v3/email/risk/ using Didit. Supports fraud signals (IP, device, user agent), 4-8 character numeric or alphanumeric codes, 54 template languages, white-label branding, and per-call DECLINE policies for risky emails.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent validate API outcomes instead of assuming success?
Did the agent preserve evidence for request/response behavior and error handling?
